In detail

Part of Schwamendingen, in district 12. Residential and calm; the only hard figure that reaches this area is Kantonspolizei Zürich's burglary rate, and at 2.9 per 1,000 residents district 12 is the lowest of Zurich's twelve — 28% of the city average. The usual night-time caution for an outlying residential district applies, but nothing here is measured as elevated.

This is a limited-data assessment. Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset, and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and is labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.
Real official data point: Saatlen sits in Kreis 12, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 2.9 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 28% of the 12-district average of 10.23/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Saatlen specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.

Frequently asked questions

Is Saatlen safe?

Wandroz currently rates Saatlen in Zurich as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Saatlen safe at night?

At night, Saatlen is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Saatlen a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Saatlen's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
